title: Ivanhoe
summary: Set in medieval England, 'Ivanhoe' follows the adventures of Sir Wilfred of Ivanhoe, a brave and noble knight who returns from exile to support his father Cedric's cause during a time of Saxon-Norman tension. Amidst political intrigue, tournaments, and battles for love, Ivanhoe falls in love with the beautiful Lady Rowena while facing hostility from the sinister Baron Front-de-Bîef. The novel weaves themes of chivalry, loyalty, and justice as characters navigate a turbulent era marked by prejudice and power struggles.
